title: Giving uncertainty some clear boundaries
meaning: Shared will becomes clearer when you distinguish a possibility, a trial action and a feeling that does not yet establish a conclusion.
text: When the picture is incomplete, a shared choice can develop cautiously and unevenly. The Moon in the physical position of Manipura describes tentative actions influenced by an impression: testing one option, stepping back and seeking another. The Moon in energy identifies the motive, finding certainty, sometimes through a guess before examining it. The Moon in emotions makes experience changeable: hope can quickly become doubt. These are three roles for one image, rather than intensified foresight: action within uncertainty, the wish to leave it and the feeling accompanying that search.

Suppose you rearrange storage space together. The new layout seems inconvenient, but each imagines a different inconvenience. **Uncertainty becomes a shared task when it can be described.** You place objects temporarily and check what is difficult to reach. One concrete experience lets you refine an impression without immediately believing the other person’s feeling or declaring your own wrong because it differs.

The difficulty is answering every doubt with another alteration. Objects travel between shelves while certainty fails to grow, since no arrangement has had time to become experience. Trying to remove uncertainty through action, you prolong it. Shared decisions benefit from distinguishing what you know, what seems possible and what you are actually examining now. Feelings retain a place without governing the entire next step.
